legal.draftNotice: Draft — the final text will be added before sales open.
legal.termsIntro: Terms for the sale of tickets to Krzyżowa-Music festival concerts.
legal.privacyIntro: How personal data is handled in the ticket shop.
legal.t1body: Legal entity name, registered address, tax and registry numbers, contact details. To be completed by the organiser.
legal.t2body: These terms cover the sale of admission tickets to concerts held as part of the festival. Tickets are personalised — a name is recorded for each ticket.
legal.t3body: One order covers tickets for a single concert. Prices are shown in złoty and euro; the currency is fixed when the order is placed and does not change. Payment is handled by an external provider.
legal.t4body: Tickets are sent to the email address given in the order, as a PDF and as a link. Admission is by QR code.
legal.t5body: To be completed and confirmed by a lawyer. Services connected with leisure events on a specified date are excluded from the 14-day right of withdrawal under EU and Polish consumer law. Refund rules are set by the organiser.
legal.t6body: How and within what period complaints are handled. To be completed.
legal.t7body: Governing law, how these terms may change, dispute resolution. To be completed.
legal.p1body: Name and contact details of the controller and, if appointed, the data protection officer. To be completed.
legal.p2body: Buyer data: email address, name, optionally phone and invoicing details. Attendee data: the name given for each ticket — including where the attendee is not the buyer.
legal.p3body: Fulfilling the order, delivering tickets, admission control, and accounting and tax obligations.
legal.p4body: The payment provider, the email provider, and the hosting and database providers. All infrastructure is located in the European Union.
legal.p5body: Buyer and attendee data is anonymised a defined period after the end of the festival edition, keeping records required by accounting law.
legal.p6body: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, objection and data portability, and the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority.
legal.p7body: Email address for data protection enquiries. To be completed.
